# Ticket 157 / auto-QA t-nv-2: the one-way-in traps of the bots' world graph (reachable from Lith
# Harbor 104000000, no route back over portals, scripted warps and BotTransit rides).
# Most are by design (PQ stages, jump-quest prize rooms, boss altars: the way out is an NPC or a
# timer). A trap missing from this list fails t-nv-2. Regenerate after a deliberate data change:
#   mvn -o test -Dtest=NavTrapQaTest -Dwz-path=<wz> -DnavTrap.write=<this file>
